findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_company_board, read_page, extract_page, check_email, detect_tech_stack, search_hacker_news, hiring_summary, app_store_lookup, company_lookup, new_businesses, company_search, find_x402_api · Private data: extract_page, check_email, domain_lookup, search_company_registry, hiring_summary, federal_contracts, new_businesses, company_search, find_x402_api · Public sink: find_company_board, check_email, domain_lookup, detect_tech_stack, hiring_summary, company_lookup, new_businesses, company_search, find_x402_api · Destructive: new_businesses.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_company_board, read_page, extract_page, check_email, detect_tech_stack, search_hacker_news, hiring_summary, app_store_lookup, company_lookup, new_businesses, company_search, find_x402_api · Private data: extract_page, check_email, domain_lookup, search_company_registry, hiring_summary, federal_contracts, new_businesses, company_search, find_x402_api · Public sink: find_company_board, check_email, domain_lookup, detect_tech_stack, hiring_summary, company_lookup, new_businesses, company_search, find_x402_api · Destructive: new_businesses

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
